topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 29 project-authored contract(s) across 3 chain(s); 2 ERC20 tokens; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 2 common project-authored base contract(s) (hubspokeevents, basesynonympricesource). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
